estonia.description: Police apprehended 10 illegal immigrants in Tallinn's Nõmme district on Sunday evening. Nine were taken directly to a detention center, while one was transported to a hospital by paramedics for further medical treatment.

estonia.title: Estonian foreign ministry strongly advises against travel to Saudi Arabia
estonia.description: Due to increasingly frequent attacks by Houthi rebels, Estonia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly advises against travel to Saudi Arabia and the surrounding region.

estonia.title: Estonia experiencing a garmoshka boom
estonia.description: Estonia is experiencing a boom in the popularity of the garmoshka, the simplest type of accordion. On Saturday, 70 garmoshka players from across Estonia gathered at the Oisu community center to make music together.

estonia.title: Eerik-Niiles Kross: The true impact of Trump and Putin's diesel deal
estonia.description: The agreement's economic impact will likely be minimal, while its moral and political consequences could be far more lasting and extremely damaging to the U.S. in the long run, writes Eerik-Niiles Kross.

estonia.title: Foreign online studies not enough to meet Estonia's compulsory education requirement
estonia.description: Children under 18 living in Estonia must attend an Estonian school to fulfill compulsory education requirements, even if they are enrolled in a foreign online school, the Ministry of Education has said.

estonia.title: President Alar Karis: Difficult to convey others' messages when you're sidelined
estonia.description: Reflecting on his five years in office, President Alar Karis defends his decisions to veto legislation and his approach to foreign policy, arguing that the president should have a greater role in shaping Estonia's foreign policy.

estonia.title: Prime minister slams US-Russia diesel pact: Deals with dictators 'road to hell'
estonia.description: Prime Minister Kristen Michal has sharply criticized the US decision to strike a diesel deal with Russia, saying agreements with dictators lead to hell.

estonia.title: Estonian Artists' Association's charity auction brings in record-breaking €2.3 million
estonia.description: The Estonian Artists' Association (EKL) charity auction concluded with total sales of €2.3 million, the highest amount ever recorded for a single art auction in Estonia.

estonia.title: Vegan powerlifter says diet change solved his health problems
estonia.description: Powerlifter Gert Koovit says switching to a vegan diet nine years ago solved his joint pain and health problems, adding his recovery has improved significantly.

estonia.title: Estonia's central bank adds stone barrier after multiple vehicle strikes
estonia.description: After multiple instances of the building being hit by vehicles, the Bank of Estonia has installed street-side rock barriers.

estonia.title: Mari-Liis Jakobson: Are we sailing to the end with a minority government?
estonia.description: Can Estonia's current minority government make it to the finish line or are we heading toward early elections, asks Mari‑Liis Jakobson.

estonia.title: Estonia condemns US sanctions on International Criminal Court
estonia.description: Estonia's Foreign Ministry has publicly condemned US sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC), joining a growing list of countries criticizing the move.

estonia.title: Minister: We have been pressuring Silmet to cut Russian raw material reliance
estonia.description: Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna says an Estonian rare earth processing firm must set a deadline for ending its use of Russian raw materials, suggesting early next year as a target.

estonia.title: Raul Eamets: Estonia is haunted by an overblown debt‑burden specter
estonia.description: We forget two factors when talking about the growth of the debt burden — factors that affect the whole picture: economic growth and price growth, writes Raul Eamets.

estonia.title: Feature: Spanish jets leave Ämari — but the Baltic mission goes on
estonia.description: NATO's Baltic air mission is now over 20 years old and was recently upgraded to a defense posture — making it high time to visit Ämari Air Base to catch up on developments.

estonia.title: Gallery: Broadcasting Museum spotlights trailblazers of Estonian radio
estonia.description: From Estonia's earliest radio hosts to its first woman announcer, a new exhibition in Türi celebrates ten people who shaped the early days of Estonian broadcasting.

estonia.title: Snow worries a key question ahead of Otepää biathlon world championships
estonia.description: With less than two months until the biathlon season starts, snow is the key question for organizers of the World Championships in Otepää, Valga County, in February.

estonia.title: Center Party overtakes Isamaa to top party ratings
estonia.description: The opposition Center Party has risen to the top of Estonia's party ratings with 23 percent support, overtaking Isamaa, according to a recent poll.

estonia.title: British Army deploys Nyan deep-strike drones in Estonia
estonia.description: A British unit at Tapa has deployed Nyan attack drone systems with a range of over 250 kilometers, boosting the allies' long-range strike capability, Postimees reported.

estonia.title: Ex-justice chancellor: Orthodox church has slim chance in European court
estonia.description: Ex-justice chancellor Allar Jõks says the Estonian Christian Orthodox Church and Pühtitsa Convent have little chance in European court after filing a complaint prematurely.

estonia.title: Estonia plans up to €5 million payments to municipalities that allow wind farms
estonia.description: Minister of Energy Erkki Keldo has sent for approval a draft regulation that would create the possibility to pay local governments up to €5 million in support to encourage the construction of wind farms on their territory.

estonia.title: Estonia pushes firm to drop Russian supplier after EU strategic project nod
estonia.description: Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna (Eesti 200) expects NPM Silmet to set a deadline for ending the use of Russian raw materials as it receives EU backing for a major expansion.

estonia.title: Estonia pays family caregivers just €60 a month, with no national scheme
estonia.description: Thousands of people in Estonia care for loved ones at home, but caregiver benefits vary widely by municipality and average just €60 a month.

estonia.title: Estonia plans to add photos of pedophile offenders to criminal records database
estonia.description: The Ministry of Justice has sent for approval a draft law that would display document‑style photos in the criminal records database of people who have a restriction on working with children.

estonia.title: Warnings before mobile traffic cameras reduced fines by 90 percent
estonia.description: Speeding fines have dropped nearly 90% since July's higher intervention threshold and the August rollout of warning signs before mobile speed cameras. But the police says safer road design, not enforcement, is the real key to improving traffic safety.

estonia.title: Expert: Longer lifespans should mean longer working lives
estonia.description: The retirement age in Estonia must rise together with life expectancy so that the pension system remains sustainable and different generations spend roughly the same amount of time in retirement, says Lauri Leppik, professor of social and population policy at Tallinn University.

estonia.title: Northeastern Estonian cities question value of participatory budgeting
estonia.description: Narva and Narva-Jõesuu are both reconsidering participatory budgeting as residents' proposals continue to prove too costly or vague to carry out.

estonia.title: Defense Intel Chief: Russia targeting Ukraine's railways and Dnipro bridges in escalating strike campaign
estonia.description: Moscow has introduced a new tactic and is attempting, through extensive long‑range strikes, to break Ukraine's infrastructure and the population's psychological resilience, says Col. Ants Kiviselg, head of the EDF Intelligence Center.

estonia.title: Developers crowd into Lüganuse as municipality navigates project surge
estonia.description: Lüganuse municipality in Ida‑Viru County has become a favorite location for various developers, which has forced the municipality to hire additional staff to process planning applications.

estonia.title: Parties struggle to navigate new EU rules on political advertising
estonia.description: With five months to go until the elections, parties are still unsure how they may legally run political ads this year. A new European Union rule meant to increase funding transparency has also created confusion and added bureaucracy.

estonia.title: Lihtsad uudised 9. oktoobril
estonia.description: "Lihtsad uudised," meaning easy or simple news, is for anyone who wants to improve their Estonian language skills. Read a selection of this week's news stories below.

estonia.title: Seda viga ei tohi novembrikuust alates teha: Ryanair karmistas olulist piirangut
estonia.description: Alates 10. novembrist jõustub kommertslennufirma Ryanair reisijatele oluline muudatus: lennujaamas suletakse registreerimis- ja pagasilauad senisest varem. Kui varasemalt sai äraantavat pagasit üle anda kuni 40 minutit enne lennu plaanipärast väljumist, siis uue korra kohaselt sulguvad lauad täpselt 60 minutit enne õhkutõusu.

estonia.title: SALAPÄRANE LENNUREIS ⟩ Oleg Grossi ettevõte sai keskkonnaametilt eriloa Vilsandile lendamiseks
estonia.description: Vilsandi rahvuspargis võivad lennud toimuda vaid keskkonnaameti eriloa alusel.

estonia.title: RAINER SAKS ⟩ Putin valmistub Trumpilt veel kingitusi saama
estonia.description: Kõik saavad tänu USA presidendi enda septembris tehtud avaldustele aru, et tema eesmärk on saavutada mootorikütuste hinna langus USA tanklates enne kongressi vahevalimisi ning täpselt nii saavad sellest kõik aru ka Venemaal, kirjutab julgeolekuekspert Rainer Saks (Parempoolsed).

estonia.title: Pahad tüdrukud vallutavad ekraani: sügis näitab naiste tumedat poolt
estonia.description: Netflix on toonud vaid kahenädalase vahega ekraanile kaks uut seriaali, mille tegevus viib meid 19. sajandi lõpu Ameerikasse ning mille keskmes on kaks naist, kes ei kavatsegi leppida neile ühiskonna poolt määratud rolliga.

estonia.title: VIDEO ⟩ Raketihäire lükkas avavilet edasi, aga taas skoorinud kõmuline Ronaldo liigub suure sihi kursil
estonia.description: Koondises skandaali tekitanud Cristiano Ronaldo ei lase kõrvalisel müral end segada. Portugali jalgpallitäht skooris Al Nassri eest teist mängu järjest.

estonia.title: KUUUURIJA ⟩ «Me liigume anarhia poole!» Tallinna 21. koolis murdis kaheksa-aastane tüdruk ninaluu: isa süüdistab ühiskonnas levivat karistamatust
estonia.description: Esmaspäeval, 12. oktoobril eetris olnud «Kuuuurija» saates rääkis kolme lapse isa Mark Luts murettekitavast juhtumist Tallinna 21. koolis, kus tema kaheksa-aastane tütar sai vahetunnis toimunud kokkupõrkes ninaluumurru. Isa sõnul ei ole tegemist pelgalt ühe õnnetusjuhtumiga, vaid märgiga sellest, et Eesti koolides väljub laste käitumine üha enam kontrolli alt.

estonia.title: Stockholmis kadus jäljetult üle 30 linnaliinibussi
estonia.description: Selle aasta oktoobris jäi kadunuks 38 Stockholmi linnaliinibussi. Juhtumiga seoses on algatatud kriminaalasi.

estonia.title: VAIKIV EPIDEEMIA ⟩ See «normaalseks» peetud haigus laastab 190 miljoni naise elu
estonia.description: Maailmas kannatab ligi 190 miljonit naist kroonilise ja piinava haiguse all, mille diagnoosimiseks võib kuluda üle aastakümne ning millele täielikku ravi ei leidu. Endometrioos põhjustab väljakannatamatut valu ja viljatust, kuid ühiskondlik teadmatus ning vaevuste alahindamine jätavad paljud abita.

estonia.title: Suri «Breaking Badi» näitleja RJ Mitte
estonia.description: «Breaking Badi» sarjas Walter White’i poega mänginud näitleja RJ Mitte suri 34-aastaselt enesetapu tagajärjel, kinnitas tema esindaja. Ajuhalvatusega elanud Mitte oli lisaks näitlejatööle tuntud ka puuetega inimeste õiguste eestkõnelejana, vahendab People.

estonia.title: TAGASTA POODI ⟩ Coop hoiatab võimaliku salmonellaohu eest munades
estonia.description: Coop kutsub ettevaatusabinõuna müügilt tagasi Kotimaista vabalt peetavate kanade munad, sest toote puhul on tekkinud salmonellakahtlus.

estonia.title: PÄEVAHOROSKOOP ⟩ 13. oktoober: Sõnnide fookuses on suhted ja koostöö, Kaaludel tõusevad esile isiklikud väärtused
estonia.description: Toredat teisipäeva!

estonia.title: Sulanud polaarjää pani ka Lõuna Koread katsetama uut laevateed
estonia.description: Lõuna-Korea konteinerlaev naasis pühapäeval katsereisilt läbi Arktika, katsetades merejää sulamise tõttu avanenud alternatiivset marsruuti ajal, mil Lähis-Ida konflikt häirib ülemaailmset laevaliiklust. Hiina on juba mõnda aega kaalunud uut mereteed Euroopa suunas.

estonia.title: ICE’i agendid korraldasid reidi demokraadist saadiku koju
estonia.description: Ameerika Ühendriikide immigratsiooni- ja tolliameti politsei (ICE) uurijad korraldasid esmaspäeval reidi Demokraatliku Partei kongressi saadiku Ilhan Omari koju.

latvia.title: Europe Today: Trump claims Ukraine-Russia energy ceasefire as Baltics stay on alert
latvia.description: Donald Trump says Russia and Ukraine have agreed an energy ceasefire. Volodymyr Zelenskyy says it was news to him. As he addresses the Warsaw Security Forum, we hear from Latvia's FM Baiba Braže, Doha after a deadly Riyadh airport attack, and France's debt fears.

latvia.title: Távozik a HUN-REN régi vezetése, amellyel a kormány kizártnak tartotta az együttműködést
latvia.description: Gulyás Balázs elnök és Jakab Roland vezérigazgató közös megegyezéssel távoznak a kutatási hálózat éléről.

latvia.title: Zelenszkij kemény üzenetet küldött a frontról: hat-nyolcszoros orosz túlerővel néznek szembe - Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index keddi hírösszefoglalója
latvia.description: Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index keddi hírösszefoglalója.

latvia.title: Beleállt Renátóba a Házasság első látásra Mercijének édesapja
Megszületett a NATO nagy terve: Szentpétervárra és Kalinyingrádra is lecsapnának, ha támadnának az oroszok
latvia.description: A NATO legmagasabb rangú katonai parancsnoka, Alexus Grynkewich tábornok hétfőn Varsóban ismertette a szövetség új katonai stratégiáját, amelyet az orosz fenyegetés elhárítására dolgoztak ki a keleti szárnyon. A terv az ukrajnai háború tanulságaira építve drónok, autonóm rendszerek és nagy hatótávolságú fegyverek kombinációjával kívánja megállítani az esetleges orosz támadást, miközben igyekszik elkerülni a nukleáris eszkaláció kockázatát - közölte a Wall Street Journal .

latvia.title: Mindenkinél kihúzta a gyufát Trump döntése, megtört Kijev ellenállása az egyik legfontosabb kérdésben - Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúból hétfőn
latvia.description: Az orosz dízelexport tilalmának ideiglenes feloldásával Donald Trump messze nem csak a NATO-tagállamokat döbbentette le: a republikánusok nagy része is felháborodott az ötleten. Mint kiderült, az amerikai elnök konkrétan megfenyegette Kijevet is: ha nem állítja le az orosz petrokémiai célpontok támadását, Washington beszünteti a fegyverszállítmányokat, majd az ukránok válaszát meg sem várva hirdetett tűzszünetet. Kijev egy másik ponton is megtörni látszik: Vologyimir Zelenszkij elnök veszít népszerűségéből, és bejelentette, hogy a korábbiakkal ellentétben mégis hajlandó kiírni a tartós béke előtt a választásokat, ha Moszkva belemegy egy 60 napos fegyvernyugvásba. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfontosabb híreivel.

latvia.title: Ez nagyon kínos: pillanatok alatt összeomlott Trump nagy tűzszünete
latvia.description: Volodimir Zelenszkij ukrán elnök szerint Ukrajna betartotta a tűzszünetet, ennek ellenére a kezdeményezés az első pillanatban összeomlott – írja az RBK Ukraine.

latvia.title: Four go on trial in Warsaw over arson attacks carried out on Russian orders
latvia.description: The gang targeted large commercial premises in Poland, Lithuania and Latvia.

latvia.title: Komisarz do spraw obronności: potrzebujemy obrony hybrydowej
latvia.description: Podział pracy między NATO a Unią Europejską jest bardzo jasny - mówił w TVN24 BiS Andrius Kubilius, europejski komisarz do spraw obrony i przestrzeni kosmicznej. Przedstawił trzy cele polityki obronnej UE, w tym stworzenie "wojskowego Schengen".

latvia.title: Bulharsko žiada EÚ a NATO o pomoc, chce objasniť dronové útoky na lode v Čiernom mori
latvia.description: Bulharsko žiada EÚ a NATO o pomoc s vyšetrovaním dronových útokov na dve lode v Čiernom mori. Jedna sa potopila, dvanásť námorníkov je stále nezvestných.

latvia.title: Le Payaco a Puding pani Elvisovej oslavujú tri dekády novým singlom a koncertnou šnúrou
latvia.description: Dve samostatné skupiny, dva odlišné hudobné žánre, no rovnaké okrúhle jubileum. Le Payaco a Puding pani Elvisovej oslavujú tento rok 30 rokov na hudobnej scéne. Oslavy odštartovali spoločnou skladbou Opustím mesto, ku ktorej natočili aj zábavný videoklip z prostredia curlingu.

latvia.title: Firemný newsfilter: Na východe vyrastie americký závod na betón aj pre Ukrajinu. Aliter získal rekordný kontrakt od NATO
latvia.description: Európsky automobilový priemysel čelí čoraz silnejšej konkurencii z Číny a od politikov žiada väčšiu podporu. Jeho problémy sa týkajú aj Slovenska, ktoré je svetovým lídrom vo výrobe osobných áut na obyvateľa. Generálny riaditeľ Volkswagenu Oliver Blume vyhlásil, že od Európskej únie očakáva vytvorenie nových podmienok, ktoré najväčšej európskej automobilke pomôžu s reštrukturalizáciou. Zmeny by podľa neho mali zároveň chrániť […]

latvia.title: Zastavit, otupit, zlomit. NATO představilo plán, jak rozdrtit Rusko
latvia.description: Vrchní velitel spojeneckých sil v Evropě, americký generál Alexus Grynkewich, v pondělí představil plán, jak rychle porazit Rusko v případě, že se Moskva rozhodne zaútočit na NATO. Teorie vítězství, jak je tento plán nazván, počítá se třemi fázemi, během nichž aliance nejprve zablokuje ruský útok, následně otupí ofenzivu a nakonec zlomí nepřítele. Generál ujistil, že pokud by k útoku došlo, NATO by rozdrtilo kohokoli, kdo by jej vedl. Druhým dechem však generál dodal, že doufá, že nebude muset nikdy vydat rozkaz, kterým by plán aktivoval.

latvia.title: Rusko může přistoupit k závažnějším operacím, varuje šéf BIS
latvia.description: Rusko by v příštích měsících mohlo v Česku či jiné demokratické zemi přistoupit k rizikovějším a závažnějším operacím, uvedl ředitel Bezpečnostní informační služby (BIS) Michal Koudelka. Mohlo by dle něj například provést sabotážní útoky na objekty, které pomáhají Ukrajině, zaútočit dronem či raketou na sklad zbraní určených pro Kyjev nebo uskutečnit omezenou vojenskou akci vůči některé členské zemi NATO. Zopakoval, že Rusko je pro tuzemsko největší zahraniční bezpečnostní hrozbou a dlouho bude.

latvia.title: Bulgaria cere ajutorul UE și NATO pentru ancheta privind atacurile cu drone din Marea Neagră
latvia.description: Bulgaria a cerut Uniunii Europene și NATO asistență tehnică pentru investigarea atacurilor cu drone care au vizat două nave comerciale în Marea Neagră, la o săptămână după ce atacurile au dus la scufundarea uneia dintre nave și la avarierea celeilalte.

latvia.title: Fostul ministru ucrainean de Externe: „Rusia nu are nevoie de 400.000 de soldați pentru a ataca NATO. Are nevoie de cinci drone”
latvia.description: Fostul ministru de externe al Ucrainei, Dmitro Kuleba, avertizează că Rusia pregătește o confruntare mai amplă cu Europa și că Vladimir Putin ar putea testa NATO prin atacuri cu drone asupra infrastructurii critice, notează POLITICO. El spune, totodată, că Ucraina se pregătește pentru cea mai grea iarnă de la începutul războiului.

latvia.title: Câți bani a cheltuit Elon Musk pentru a-i ajuta pe republicani să păstreze controlul asupra Congresului SUA
latvia.description: Generozitatea lui Musk, despre care a relatat anterior New York Times, îl face pe cel mai bogat om din lume, probabil, cel mai mare donator politic din campaniile electorale din acest an, potrivit datelor privind finanțarea campaniilor electorale.

latvia.title: România, invitată de onoare la Târgul de Carte Frankfurt, dar fără vreun plan: „Azi am rupt pisica, ştie fiecare că celălalt aşteaptă”
latvia.description: Participarea României cu statut de ţară invitată de onoare la Târgul de Carte de la Frankfurt 2028, cel mai mare din industrie, nu se bazează, după şase luni de la obţinerea acestui statut, nici pe un program, nici pe o entitate coordonatoare şi nici pe un buget, sunt câteva dintre concluziile întâlnirii de luni, de la Ministerul Culturii, dintre reprezentanţii MC, ai instituţiilor şi asociaţiilor de cultură şi ai presei. Doar cinci oameni din Ministerul Culturii, cei care gestionează târgurile de carte, nu se pot ocupa de un proiect de o asemenea anvergură, a anunţat ministrul Culturii. Ministrul Culturii declară că, în aşteptarea unei oferte de la Asociaţia Editorilor din România (AER), a propus Oficiului de Film şi Investiţii Culturale (OFIC) să preia rolul de manager de proiect, o decizie controversată şi contestată. Pentru a avea un buget şi o desemnare de manager de proiect este nevoie de o Hotărâre de Guvern, care în prezent este în stadiul de draft.

latvia.title: NATO trebuie să pregătească un răspuns ferm la un posibil atac hibrid mortal al Rusiei, spune șeful diplomației poloneze
latvia.description: Membrii NATO ar trebui să pregătească un răspuns ferm la un eventual atac „hibrid” mortal din partea Rusiei, a declarat ministrul polonez al Afacerilor Externe, pe fondul îngrijorării crescânde cu privire la intensificarea campaniei de sabotaj a Moscovei pe teritoriul european, relatează Financial Times.

latvia.title: Ce loc ocupă Europa printre prioritățile strategice ale SUA. Ambasadorul Matthew Whitaker: „Vă cerem doar să faceți un pas înainte”
latvia.description: NATO trebuie să-și modernizeze infrastructura militară pentru a putea deplasa forțele și echipamentele din Europa de Vest în Europa de Est, „unde ne-am aștepta să aibă loc orice conflict viitor”, a declarat luni ambasadorul SUA la NATO, Matthew Whitaker, relatează Politico.

latvia.title: Adidas a dat în judecată marca australiană White Fox pentru un design asemănător, dar cu patru dungi
latvia.description: Adidas a dat în judecată marca australiană White Fox pentru vânzarea și promovarea de articole vestimentare cu un design cu patru dungi, susținând că acesta este „înșelător de similar” cu logo-ul distinctiv al mărcii germane.

latvia.title: NATO este „gata să lupte, chiar în această seară”, dacă va fi atacată, declară comandantul suprem al forțelor NATO din Europa
latvia.description: Comandantul suprem al forţelor NATO din Europa, generalul american Alexus Grynkewich, a adresat luni un avertisment Moscovei cu privire la capacitatea Alianţei Atlantice de a contracara orice atac, în contextul în care cresc îngrijorările legate de ameninţarea rusă. NATO este „gata să lupte, chiar în această seară”, dacă va fi atacată, a dat el asigurări, potrivit Sky News.

latvia.title: Daniel Fenechiu și-a retras semnătura de pe proiectul pentru dezincriminarea posesiei de droguri: „Am crezut că vom avea o dezbatere”
latvia.description: Senatorul PNL Daniel Fenechiu a anunțat, printr-o postare pe Facebook, că și-a retras semnătura de pe proiectul pentru dezincriminarea posesiei de droguri pentru consum propriu. Liderul senatorilor liberali consideră că proiectul ar fi trebuit să genereze „un cadru ideal de discuție, în care argumentele pro și contra să fie analizate rațional, fără emoție, fără orgolii și fără interese personale”, însă a constatat că „dezbaterea nu a mai avut loc”.

latvia.title: „Trump a încheiat un pact cu diavolul”. Alianță neașteptată în Senatul SUA împotriva acordului dintre liderul de la Casa Albă și Putin
latvia.description: Legea adoptată în 2022 „interzice categoric” importul de resurse energetice rusești în SUA, motiv pentru care Donald Trump „trebuie să-și schimbe imediat cursul” în ceea ce privește acordul său cu Vladimir Putin privind livrările de motorină. Acest lucru a fost declarat de un grup de senatori, din care fac parte atât republicani, cât și democrați.

latvia.title: Operația complexă pentru tumorile de cap de pancreas
latvia.description: Tumorile localizate la nivelul capului pancreasului se află într-o regiune în care pancreasul, duodenul și căile biliare sunt strâns legate anatomic. Atunci când boala poate fi îndepărtată chirurgical, intervenția trebuie planificată astfel încât tumora să fie rezecată complet și continuitatea tubului digestiv să fie refăcută.

latvia.title: Rusia a pierdut un număr record de soldați în septembrie, potrivit datelor NATO. Câți ucraineni au rămas pe câmpul de luptă
latvia.description: Armata rusă a pierdut în septembrie peste 50.000 de oameni pe frontul din Ucraina, dintre care 28.000 au murit, a declarat pentru Bloomberg un înalt reprezentant militar al NATO.

latvia.title: Călin Georgescu, mesaj de după gratii despre „Lucrare” pentru susținătorii săi. Ce a transmis fostul candidat
latvia.description: Călin Georgescu a transmis un mesaj către susținătorii săi în timp ce se află în spatele gratiilor, în Arestul Central din București. Fostul candidat a spus că „pe unii îi simte, iar pe alții îi aude, chiar dacă nu îi vede”.

latvia.title: Comandantul suprem al NATO în Europa prezintă azi „Teoria victoriei” și va transmite un avertisment Moscovei
latvia.description: Comandantul suprem al forțelor NATO în Europa, generalul american Alexus Grynkewich, va prezenta luni, la Varșovia, modul în care Alianța ar putea învinge Rusia în cazul unui atac, în cadrul unui concept denumit „teoria victoriei”. Mesajul adresat Moscovei vine pe fondul îngrijorărilor tot mai mari ale oficialilor occidentali privind intensificarea acțiunilor de sabotaj și a altor amenințări hibride atribuite Rusiei.

latvia.title: Critici din interiorul Partidului Republican la adresa lui Trump pentru acordul cu Rusia pentru motorină. „Nu respectă legea”
latvia.description: Senatorul republican american Thom Tillis a avertizat că acordul încheiat de preşedintele Donald Trump cu Rusia pentru furnizarea de motorină pe pieţele internaţionale ar putea încălca legislaţia Statelor Unite şi ar putea pune în pericol vieţile americanilor. Tillis se alătură astfel criticilor formulate de politicieni din ambele partide.

latvia.title: Un lider UDMR vede o singură soluție pentru „o majoritate stabilă”
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor UDMR, Lorand Turos, a declarat că este necesară „o înțelegere politică între PNL și PSD” pentru formarea unui „guvern stabil, cu puteri depline și care nu depinde de votul extremiștilor”. Aflat în studioul Euronews, luni seară, alături de reprezentanți de la celelalte trei partide din fosta coaliție, Lorand Turos le-a spus celorlalți invitați …

latvia.title: Feature: Spanish jets leave Ämari — but the Baltic mission goes on
latvia.description: NATO's Baltic air mission is now over 20 years old and was recently upgraded to a defense posture — making it high time to visit Ämari Air Base to catch up on developments.

latvia.title: Telegraph: Ukraina sõltub Ühendriikidest kolmes olulises valdkonnas
latvia.description: USA president Donald Trump taasalustas ootamatult oma isiklikku kättemaksuretke Ukraina presidendi Volodõmõr Zelenskõi vastu ja tõestas taas oma vankumatut poolehoidu Kremli juhile Vladimir Putinile, kirjutas esmaspäeval väljaanne The Telegraph.

latvia.title: Zelenskõi hinnangul on Ukraina positsioonid rindel tugevad
latvia.description: Pärast kõrgema ülemjuhataja peakorteri esmaspäeval korraldatud istungit teatas president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi, et Venemaa kannab iga päev suuri kaotusi ja Ukraina positsioonid rindejoonel on tugevaimad üle pika aja.

latvia.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1693. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Zelenskõi: USA suudaks Venemaad sundida nõustuma tõelise energiarahuga
latvia.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1693. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis.2026/ukraina-kalender

latvia.title: Record number of illegal border crossing attempts forecast in Latvia
latvia.description: The number of attempted illegal border crossings on the Latvia–Belarus border this year has exceeded the total for the whole of last year – more than 12,000 attempts have been thwarted. Border guards suggest that the 2023 record could also be broken, LSM's Latgale editorial reported on October 12.

latvia.title: Tuesday will be rather rainy in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that there will be occasional showers in many parts of Latvia on Tuesday.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 12th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: airBaltic posts 128 million euro loss in first six months of the year
latvia.description: Latvian national airline airBaltic reported improved revenues in the first half of this year but still lost more than 128 million euros, the company said on October 12th.

latvia.title: 'Black Russian' sabotage group is probably a front, experts suggest
latvia.description: A little-known group called "Black Russians" has claimed responsibility for an incident on the Latvian-Belarusian border in early October, in which masked and armed men attempted to smuggle 20 illegal migrants into the country and later damaged infrastructure, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Daniils Bulajevs and Davinspiro Camerata in concert
latvia.description: On Monday, October 12th, at 18:00, Latvian Radio 3's artist-in-residence - violinist Daniils Bulajevs and his chamber orchestra Davinspiro Camerata will perform for the first time in a live concert at Latvian Radio's Studio number 1.

latvia.title: Defence hackathon happening this week in Latvia
latvia.description: From October 15th to 17th, the European Commission's Defence Innovation Programme (EUDIS) international defence innovation hackathon "Defence Hackathon 2026 Latvia" will take place at the Academic Centre of the University of Latvia (LU) in Rīga, bringing together startups, researchers, engineers and technology developers.

latvia.title: Latest naughty Saeima members named, if not shamed
latvia.description: The latest roll-call of shame for Latvia's Saeima deputies has been released and this time around 12 of the parliament's 100 members make the list blurring the borders between law maker and law breaker.

latvia.title: Polish education in Latvia in focus during Tuesday conference
latvia.description: To draw attention to the importance and development of Polish education in Latvia, as well as to emphasize the role of education in promoting national identity, cultural diversity and intercultural dialogue, a conference titled: “35 years since the revival of Polish education in Latvia. The legacy of Ita Kozakeviča and the future of Polish schools” will be held in the Saeima, Latvia's parliament, on Tuesday, October 13.

latvia.title: Court upholds prison sentence in EUR 2 million bribery case
latvia.description: The Riga Regional Court has upheld the first-instance conviction of businessman Igors Trubko for offering a bribe of 2.1 million euros to Riga City Council councillor Mārtiņš Kossovičs (Progressives), the court announced on Monday, as reported by Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Latvia's trade figures saw double-digit growth in August
latvia.description: In August 2026, Latvia's foreign trade turnover amounted to 3.84 billion euros, which was 13.7% more in current prices than a year ago, according to preliminary data from the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) published on October 12th.

latvia.title: That is one very large apple pie
latvia.description: Are you interested in pies? Apple pies? Large apple pies? Extremely large apple pies? Then read on!

latvia.title: Rīga Cathedral will restore its historic chime
latvia.description: After more than 110 years, the historic chime of the bells at Riga Cathedral is to be restored. Three new church bells were consecrated on Sunday and will join the existing ones. During the First World War, four historic bells were taken from the Cathedral to Russia, of which only one returned to Latvia. The new bells were manufactured in Germany, whilst their installation was funded by donors, Latvian Radio reported on October 11.

latvia.title: The answer is blowing in the wind: Liepāja 2027 tells us what to expect
latvia.description: If the launch event on the evening of October 9th proves to be any sort of a guide, Liepāja's stint in 2027 as a European Capital of Culture will be an unusual, perplexing, dazzling, spectacular, exciting, confusing, but ultimately enjoyable experience.

latvia.title: Weather will improve toward end of week in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that there will still be occasional showers in the first half of this week, but the weather will become sunnier and slightly warmer in the second half of the week.

latvia.title: Vanšu Bridge will be open for most of renovation time, says mayor
latvia.description: During the renovation works scheduled for next autumn, the Vanšu Bridge will remain partially open to traffic, Rīga’s mayor Viesturs Kleinbergs (Progressives) said in an interview on the Latvian Television programme “Morning Panorama”.

latvia.title: Latvian Border Guard: Migration control going better but risks still there
latvia.description: Although Operation ‘Werewolf’ has improved the situation at the border, officials report significant problems both in terms of border security and in dealing with people who have already arrived in Latvia, Latvian Radio reported on October 11.

latvia.title: Night-time buses prove quite popular in Rīga, Latvia
latvia.description: Night buses in Riga have carried nearly 22,000 passengers in just under half a year. This is roughly twice as many as last year, when there were significantly fewer night routes. Most night routes ended their season at the end of September, but buses between the airport and the city centre will continue to run, Latvian Radio reported on October 12.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 11th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvians made more than 5 million trips last year
latvia.description: In 2025, there were 1.20 billion personal and professional trips made by residents in the EU, a 1.4% increase from 2024 (+17 million trips). Of the total, 848 million were domestic trips (70% of the total) and 264 million were foreign trips within the EU (22%), which means 92% of the trips made by EU residents were intra-EU. This information comes from data on trips by EU residents published by Eurostat today.

latvia.title: 'Severe' weather alert issued along Latvia's western coast
latvia.description: All of Latvia's western coastline in Kurzeme region has a severe weather warning in place for Friday afternoon and evening.

latvia.title: New species of lichen found in Latvia
latvia.description: A species of lichen, Pseudothelomma ocellatum, has been recorded in Latvia for the first time, according to the Latvian Mycological Society. The lichen was found on the grounds of the ‘Kalna Kaibēni’ museum.

latvia.title: airBaltic to suspend some routes this winter season
latvia.description: Several airBaltic passengers have been informed that their pre-paid flights have been rescheduled or cancelled. The national airline explained that one of the main factors is the rise in aviation fuel prices. Flights on several routes will resume during the summer season, but flights on the Riga–Innsbruck route will be suspended entirely, Latvian Radio reports on October 9.

latvia.title: Latvian actress Indra Briķe passes away
latvia.description: On 9 October, Indra Briķe (29 December 1957 – 9 October 2026), a long-time actress at the Dailes Theatre, passed away, as reported by ‘Kroders.lv’ and confirmed by the theatre.

latvia.title: Booze bribe case heads to court in Valmiera, Latvia
latvia.description: A case has been referred to the Vidzeme District Court in which the director of a company and another individual are accused of offering a bribe – a bottle of cognac and 1,000 euros – to an official of the Valmiera Municipal Council, and of aiding and abetting the bribery, the prosecutor's office said in a release.

latvia.title: Another toddler wanders off from same Bauska kindergarten
latvia.description: On Thursday, a three-year-old child once again wandered off unsupervised from the “Pasaulīte” kindergarten in Bauska; this is the second such incident this year, the Bauska Municipal Council told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Sound Forest, Open House, Symphony
latvia.description: If storm and rain don't scare you, here are a few things to do this weekend.

latvia.title: Smiltēns could be next Latvian Saeima Speaker
latvia.description: The Speaker of the 15th Saeima could be the current Minister for Justice, Edvards Smiltēns, of the United List, who already has experience in the role of Speaker of Parliament, according to sources at Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Pro-Kremlin activist case goes back to court in Latvia
latvia.description: The Supreme Court has annulled the Rīga Regional Court’s ruling in a case in which the defendant was sentenced to three years’ imprisonment for publicly glorifying crimes against peace and war crimes by displaying various symbols associated with Russia and the Soviet Union in the windows of her home, Latvian Television reported on October 8.

latvia.title: Strongest winds will be on Latvian western coast Friday
latvia.description: A strong wind warning will be in force in Latvia on Friday afternoon, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 7th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Two 'Latvian nationals' arrested for entering airbase in England
latvia.description: Two men described as being Latvian were arrested on October 8th on suspicion of illegally entering a Royal Air Force (RAF) military base in Cambridgeshire, England which is used by the United States Air Force.

latvia.title: 'Two-basket' healthcare system postponed again in Latvia
latvia.description: The Saeima has postponed the introduction of the so-called ‘two healthcare service baskets’ principle for a further year – until 31 December next year – as decided by parliament on Thursday during the second and final reading under an urgent procedure. The introduction of this principle has been postponed for several years now, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Annual inflation in Latvia at 3.2% in September
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau data, published on 8 October, show that compared with September 2025, the average level of consumer prices rose by 3.2 % in September 2026.

latvia.title: Wind alerts in force for Friday in Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, 9 October, strong winds are expected in Latvia, which may cause damage in some areas, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre (LVĢMC).

latvia.title: Russians, Belarusians banned from owning critical infrastructure in Latvia
latvia.description: Citizens of Russia and Belarus will not be able to acquire a significant stake or exert decisive influence in critical infrastructure facilities in Latvia, the Saeima decided on Thursday, 8 October, as reported by LSM.lv and LETA.

latvia.title: Latvian book exhibition opens at European Parliament
latvia.description: An exhibition dedicated to 500 years since the first book in Latvian was published was opened at the European Parliament (EP) building in Strasbourg this week. The exhibition was created in cooperation with the National Library of Latvia (LNB), reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Theatre director Hermanis quits as leader of party he founded

latvia.title: Flu monitoring season begins in Latvia
latvia.description: The 2026–2027 monitoring season for influenza and other acute respiratory infections has begun in Latvia, but so far, Latvia has only received the intranasal ‘Fluenz’ vaccine, which is intended for children who belong to specific health risk groups, according to the Disease Prevention and Control Centre (SPKC). This season, the production of influenza vaccines in Europe has been delayed; consequently, vaccine deliveries to Latvia are taking place gradually and slightly later than usual this year. Deliveries of the ‘Efluelda’ flu vaccine to GP practices will begin this week. This vaccine is intended for people aged 60 and over, as well as those with moderate or severe immunosuppression. Meanwhile, the “Vaxigrip” vaccine, which is intended for other target groups eligible for state-funded vaccination – including adults and children with chronic illnesses – is expected to arrive in Latvia by 13 November. This season, state-funded flu vaccination will be provided using three vaccines, each intended for different population groups. The first laboratory-confirmed cases of flu in Latvia this season were recorded even before the start of the flu monitoring season and were linked to travel outside Latvia. Meanwhile, in week 40 of 2026, when monitoring began, influenza was clinically diagnosed in three patients, or 3.9 cases per 100,000 population, which is lower than during the corresponding period of the previous season (9.9 cases per 100,000 population). A total of 918 patients, or an average of 1,179.3 per 100,000 population, consulted their GPs with symptoms of other acute respiratory infections. The prevalence of other acute respiratory infections is also slightly lower than during the corresponding period of the previous season. Last week, influenza was not laboratory-confirmed in any of the 166 samples tested, whilst RSV infection was confirmed in one sample (0.6 per cent), according to laboratory surveillance data. The proportion of Covid-19-positive samples was 1.2 per cent, remaining at roughly the same level as the previous week. Unlike in previous years, no increase in Covid-19 cases was observed in late summer and early autumn this year.

lithuania.title: Zelenskõi hinnangul on Ukraina positsioonid rindel tugevad
lithuania.description: Pärast kõrgema ülemjuhataja peakorteri esmaspäeval korraldatud istungit teatas president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi, et Venemaa kannab iga päev suuri kaotusi ja Ukraina positsioonid rindejoonel on tugevaimad üle pika aja.

lithuania.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1693. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Zelenskõi: USA suudaks Venemaad sundida nõustuma tõelise energiarahuga
lithuania.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1693. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis.2026/ukraina-kalender

lithuania.title: VIDEO. Pie Solmenkas notikusi kravas auto un vieglā spēkrata sadursme – viens transportlīdzeklis apgāzies
lithuania.description: Uz A13 šosejas pie Solmenkas notikusi kravas automašīnas un vieglā auto sadursme, pēc kuras kravas transportlīdzeklis apgāzies uz sāniem. lithuania.title: Asta Skaisgirytė ragina vertinant JAV išlaikyti blaivią galvą, žiūrėti strateginio paveikslo
lithuania.description: Prezidento vyriausioji patarėja užsienio politikos klausimais Asta Skaisgirytė antradienį pareiškė, kad JAV sprendžiant dėl karių dislokavimo Europoje ir Lietuvoje, reikia išlaikyti blaivią galvą, vengti emocijų ir rūpintis strateginiais klausimais.

lithuania.title: Rusijos dronui pataikius į daugiabutį Kyjive žuvo du žmonės, dar keli sužeisti
lithuania.description: Rusijos pajėgoms pirmadienio vakarą dronu atakavus daugiabutį Kyjive, žuvo du žmonės, dar keli buvo sužeisti.

lithuania.title: Visagine sulaikytas iš senolės išviliotų pinigų pasiimti atėjęs sukčius
lithuania.description: Pirmadienį Visagine sukčiai iš 76 metų moters mėgino išvilioti 4800 eurų, tačiau pinigų pasiimti atvykęs vyras buvo sulaikytas policijos pareigūnų.

lithuania.title: Kėdainiuose žmonės įstrigo prekybos centro lifte, Elektrėnuose – logistikos centro tualete
lithuania.description: Pirmadienį ugniagesiams teko vykti į du neįprastus iškvietimus, kai žmonės negalėjo savarankiškai išeiti iš uždarų patalpų.

lithuania.title: Žiniasklaida: per migrantų krizę Marokas pažeidė Seutos vandenis
lithuania.description: Maroko kariniai laivai liepą per migrantų krizę ir po jos buvo įplaukę į Seutos vandenis, taip pažeisdami Ispanijos suverenitetą šioje Šiaurės Afrikos teritorijoje, į kurią taip pat pretenduoja Rabatas, pirmadienį pranešė žiniasklaida.

lithuania.title: Vilniuje per vieną naktį – trys vagystės: dingo pinigai, įrankiai ir motoroleris
lithuania.description: Pirmadienį Vilniuje policija pradėjo tris atskirus ikiteisminius tyrimus dėl vagysčių. Per kelias valandas iš baro, statybvietės ir automobilių stovėjimo aikštelės pavogta turto už mažiausiai 4,7 tūkst. eurų.

lithuania.title: Vilniuje per kelias valandas apgadinti du „Toyota“ automobiliai
lithuania.description: Pirmadienį Vilniuje užfiksuoti du atskiri atvejai, kai buvo apgadinti „Toyota“ automobiliai. Bendras abiem savininkams padarytas nuostolis siekia 2,5 tūkst. eurų.

lithuania.title: Marijampolės „Regitroje“ vyras bandė laikyti teorijos egzaminą už kitą asmenį
lithuania.description: Marijampolėje policija pradėjo ikiteisminį tyrimą dėl neįprasto incidento „Regitros“ padalinyje. Įtariama, kad vyras vairuotojų teorijos egzaminą galėjo laikyti apsimesdamas kitu asmeniu.
